stories.excerpt: Chargé d’Affaires Mikael Cleverley cuts the cake as the U.S. Embassy Uganda marked America’s 250th anniversary during its National Day celebration on…
stories.summary: Embassy Uganda marked America’s 250th anniversary during its National Day celebration on September 24. American investment, innovation, and technology are actively contributing to the Government of Uganda’s tenfold economic growth agenda, the US Embassy Chargé d’Affaires Mikael Cleverley has said. According to Mr Cleverley, the celebration underscored the growing depth of the US-Uganda relationship, particularly in health cooperation, commercial diplomacy, and enduring people-to-people ties.
